author: HideOnKush
body: My username is EthanHuang and my account was banned wrongly for ban evading. I have never played on this server, but the moment my friend told me to try it, I got banned. I was at a sleepover at my friend's house so our IP address was the same. Please unban me because I have played Minecraft for over 4 years and never played Nebula.
